options.name: core
options.description: The public agent channel and the internal API of admin it relays to.

settings.name: agentChannelPort
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_AGENT_CHANNEL_PORT: Port of the public agent channel (the image sets 7100).

settings.name: agentChannelBind
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_AGENT_CHANNEL_BIND: Address of the public agent channel (an IP address).

settings.name: adminUrl
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_EDGE_ADMIN_URL: The http(s) URL of the internal API of admin.

settings.name: internalApiSecret
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_INTERNAL_API_SECRET_FILE: The shared secret for the internal API of admin (a mounted secret file).

settings.name: trustedProxy
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_EDGE_TRUSTED_PROXY: Whether the edge sits behind a trusted proxy (x-forwarded-for is then the client).
